sourceText: Operator directive for the repro-first program: the convergence breaker keeps freezing stories that are making genuine incremental progress across different gate rejections, and each unfreeze costs an interactive human TTY acknowledgement. Fix the highest-friction known workflow bug with a deliberately narrow change before driving the remaining program stories through the same gates.
normalizedOutcome: A story that fixes one gate gap and then hits a different gate gap keeps its gate-failure counter at 1 per distinct failure and is no longer frozen, so no interactive human TTY acknowledgement is needed to continue, while two genuine retries of the same failure still accumulate to 2 and still trip the breaker.
acceptanceClaim: gateFailureDigest produces one counter key per substantively distinct gate rejection and one shared key per incidentally-different retry of the same rejection, proven in both directions by a smoke matrix that asserts the resulting gate-failure counter value.
